title: Budget health progression
summary: Move Alice's individual budget through healthy, warning, high-risk, and 100% states.

steps.title: Reach 40%
steps.description: Alice consumes 2,000 AI credits from the shared pool a week into the billing period.
steps.expected: The individual ULB reaches $20 of $50 (40%) without an alert.

steps.title: Cross the warning threshold
steps.description: Another 2,000 credits raise total user consumption to $40.
steps.expected: The ULB reaches 80% and its 75% alert fires.

steps.title: Reach the high-risk state
steps.description: A 500-credit event raises the budget to 90%.
steps.expected: The 90% alert fires and only $5 of headroom remains.

steps.title: Inspect before 100%
steps.description: Pause with the budget at 90% before applying the final usage event.
steps.expected: The inline outcome shows that the next 500-credit step will reach exactly 100%.

steps.title: Reach 100%
steps.description: The final 500 credits consume the remaining $5 of user budget.
steps.expected: The event is accepted at the exact limit and the 100% alert fires.
